body:
sam-cs: FYI Acmeprod (customer) getting lots of 429s + queued requests. Ticket CS-4521 https://redwood/support/CS-4521
sam-cs: Symptoms: ~200 rps for 15m, client timeouts. Autoscaler did not create >2 replicas (min_replicas=2). Warm-pool attachment stuck in 'attaching' state for ~12m.
sam-cs: Kube events show ErrImagePull for gpu-runtime image and a 401 from registry: "rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = invalid token"
lee-oncall: Hmm could be registry token rotated. @sarah-eng can you check registries + attach controller logs?
sarah-eng: Pulling logs now. Autoscaler shows PodCreateFailed -> backoff. kube events: "Failed to pull image \"gcr.redwood/gpu-runtime:v12\": rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = invalid token". Attach controller retries hit timeout.
sarah-eng: Repro snippet from node:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning  Failed     12m   kubelet, gpu-45     Failed to pull image "gcr.redwood/gpu-runtime:v12": rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = invalid token
  Normal   BackOff    11m   kubelet, gpu-45     Back-off pulling image "gcr.redwood/gpu-runtime:v12"
```
jonathan: Also noticed gpu-45 reporting 98-100% GPU memory for other pods (noisy neighbor). Scheduler avoids that node so effective capacity is lower.
maria_support: Customer mentioned a billing warning yesterday but account is active now. Confirmed there is no billing hold blocking provisioning.
sarah-eng: Quick repro steps for engineering:
1) set min_replicas=2 on a dedicated pool
2) run load: `wrk -t8 -c200 --timeout 5s http://acmeprod.api/generate` for 10m
3) watch metrics: warm_pool_attach_latency, pod_creation_failures, kube events
4) if registry token expired you'll see 401 in kubelet logs
lee-oncall: Temporary mitigation -- scaled Acmeprod to 6 replicas manually to drain the queue and acknowledged CS ticket. :thumbsup:
deploybot: canary-deploy acme-runtime:v12 -> started
jonathan: Long term actions: add alert on imagePull 401 spikes, make attach controller fallback to image-cache/warm-image if registry auth fails, improve noisy-neighbor isolation (eviction thresholds on GPU mem).
sam-cs: Told customer about manual scale. They saw immediate improvement. Leaving issue open for eng follow-ups. Thanks all :heart:
